turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Why does my son have a zero?
I didn't come for thanks. Why did Owen find out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class?
I know your family has a history with academic integrity at this school. Claire's case.
You'll want to be very careful about the next sentence, Hale. My daughter's case has nothing to do with this one, and I'll be raising that you brought it up when I'm in the principal's office.
Maybe this runs in the family.

I'm writing that down. Word for word.

You just accused my children of something with no document in your hand. Either you have evidence about Owen's essay, or I'm walking upstairs.
